lines.zh: 我贴着河底游，眼睛朝上看。
lines.en: I swim along the riverbed with my eyes turned upward.
Cold water slides past my gills.
Only when the light dims can I see clearly.

lines.zh: 两条同伴，一左一右跟着。
lines.en: Two companions trail me, one on each side.

lines.zh: 我绕过一块被水磨圆的石头。
lines.en: I round a stone worn smooth by the water.

lines.zh: 河底的沙很细，我几乎不碰。
lines.en: The river sand is fine; I barely touch it.

lines.zh: 我贴着倒木的阴影往前。
lines.en: I move along the shadow of a fallen log.

lines.zh: 冬天的水最清，我游得最远。
lines.en: Winter water is clearest, and I travel farthest.

lines.zh: 我摆尾一次，能滑出很远。
lines.en: One tail stroke carries me a long way.

lines.zh: 水面结了冰，我在下面照样走。
lines.en: Ice seals the surface; I still travel beneath it.

lines.zh: 我沿着河岸的浅沟慢慢挪。
lines.en: I work along the shallow trench by the bank.
River weeds brush against my side fin.

lines.zh: 一整条河的深浅，我都记得。
lines.en: I remember the depth of every stretch of river.
I head for deeper water, which is quieter.

lines.zh: 我顺着水流侧身，眼睛朝上。
lines.en: I turn sideways with the current, eyes still upward.

lines.zh: 我在桥墩的影子里等天黑。
lines.en: I wait in the shadow of the bridge pier for night.

lines.zh: 三条鱼一起拐弯，水纹叠起来。
lines.en: Three of us turn at once and our ripples overlap.

lines.zh: 我贴到冰下最暗的那一层。
lines.en: I press into the darkest layer beneath the ice.

lines.zh: 我悬在深水里，几乎不摆尾。
lines.en: I hang in deep water, barely moving my tail.
The stones below are cold as iron.

lines.zh: 我数着从冰面漏下的光。
lines.en: I count the light leaking through the ice.
A minnow passes and I do not move.

lines.zh: 我在等天黑，天黑好捕食。
lines.en: I wait for dusk, when hunting comes easy.

lines.zh: 河面上有人类的脚步声。
lines.en: Human footsteps sound along the riverbank.
My eyes shine in the dark water.
Winter is long; I endure it slowly.
My mouth works, but nothing comes out.
In cold water my heartbeat slows.
I stare into the current, thinking nothing.

lines.zh: 一片落叶沉下来，我让开。
lines.en: A fallen leaf sinks and I move aside.

lines.zh: 我在石缝里藏了半个身子。
lines.en: I tuck half my body into a stone gap.
Spring is far off, and I am in no hurry.

lines.zh: 我抬眼，看清你袖口的线。
lines.en: I look up and make out the stitching on your sleeve.
Your shadow sways on the river's surface.

lines.zh: 你的浮标停在河心不动。
lines.en: Your bobber sits still in mid-river.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的眼，你盯着水。
lines.en: I watch your eyes; you watch the water.

lines.zh: 你换了三次饵，我都记着。
lines.en: You swapped bait three times; I noted each one.

lines.zh: 我从水下看你，你变形的样子。
lines.en: I see you from below, warped and wavering.
You raise the rod too quickly.

lines.zh: 我又看了看你的靴子，湿了。
lines.en: I glance at your boots; they are soaked.

lines.zh: 你的手很稳，这让我警惕。
lines.en: Your hands are steady, and that makes me wary.

lines.zh: 深水里，我的眼睛比你先适应。
lines.en: In deep water my eyes adjust before yours do.

lines.zh: 你的钩撕开了我的嘴角。
lines.en: Your hook tears the corner of my mouth.

lines.zh: 血在水里散成一片淡红。
lines.en: Blood spreads pale red through the water.
The pain drives me into a stone crevice.
The blow takes away my sense of direction.
My fin splits along a long seam.
I struggle once and the line pulls tighter.

lines.zh: 你打中我的侧身，鳞掉了。
lines.en: You hit my flank and scales come loose.
Three points of life do not last long.

lines.zh: 我沉到河底，又浮了上来。
lines.en: I drop toward the bed, then lift once more.
One more blow and I turn belly up.

lines.zh: 那条小鱼挂在钩上，还在动。
lines.en: The minnow on your hook is still wriggling.
I circle once, then circle again.
In the cold, I want only one mouthful.

lines.zh: 你的饵沉得刚好，像活物。
lines.en: Your bait sinks just right, like something alive.

lines.zh: 我知道是圈套，还是靠近了。
lines.en: I know it is a trap, and come closer anyway.

lines.zh: 河底的暗流把香味送过来。
lines.en: The undercurrent carries the scent to me.

lines.zh: 我盯着那点银光，挪了半尺。
lines.en: I fix on that silver glint and shift half a foot.

lines.zh: 钓鱼佬的梦，就是这一口。
lines.en: The angler's dream is exactly this one bite.
My jaw is open before I decide.
Let it sink a little more and I strike.

lines.zh: 你踩进河里，撞散了我的队。
lines.en: You step into the river and break my line.

lines.zh: 我的侧鳍蹭过你的靴子。
lines.en: My side fin brushes against your boot.

lines.zh: 同伴蹭过来，把我挤歪了。
lines.en: A schoolmate shoulders me, and I list.
Your net sweeps across my back.

lines.zh: 我在你的膝盖边绕了一圈。
lines.en: I loop around your knee and come back.

lines.zh: 冰面碎了一块，我避开了。
lines.en: A pane of ice breaks and I dodge it.

lines.zh: 撞上了，可水花几乎没有。
lines.en: We knock together and hardly break the surface.
You step back, and I retreat with you.
A stone jabs into my side.
Stop pacing about in the shallows.
Only when spring warms the water do I seek her.
The two of us, one behind the other.
Her eyes catch more light than mine.

lines.zh: 我们贴着河底的沙并排。
lines.en: We lie side by side on the river sand.

lines.zh: 我绕着她转，尾鳍扫起细沙。
lines.en: I circle her, my tail stirring fine sand.
In the cold season we keep very close.

lines.zh: 她摆了摆尾，我就跟上去。
lines.en: She flicks her tail and I follow.

lines.zh: 水草之间，我们谁也不出声。
lines.en: Among the weeds, neither of us makes a sound.

lines.zh: 卵落进石缝，我守在旁边。
lines.en: The eggs settle into a stone gap; I keep watch.

lines.zh: 这一窝，我只管到春天末。
lines.en: I tend this brood only until spring ends.

lines.zh: 我咬住钩上的饵，不肯松。
lines.en: I clamp the bait and refuse to let go.

lines.zh: 石子落水，我当成了食物。
lines.en: A pebble drops; I take it for food.
I swim off with a shred of river weed.
Too heavy; I spit it back out.
Your bucket is too bright; I will not go in.
I try to spit the hook out.

lines.zh: 我用嘴推了推你的浮标。
lines.en: I nudge your bobber with my mouth.
Metal taste in my mouth is hard to bear.
I hold it a moment, then let go.
You reach down; I drop to the bottom.
The water shifts and I see it.
Your rod's shadow falls on mid-river.
I recognize the line above the hook.
Something is sharpening a blade on the bank.
My schoolmates scatter, and I know something is wrong.
That silver flash is not a fish.
I fix my eyes on your hand.
The danger comes from upstream.
I stiffen my fins and hold still.
You were the one who moved first.
I sink beneath the hook and wait for it.
I watch the line without blinking.
When your hand stops, I strike.
I slip closer along the undercurrent.
Three feet, two feet, one.
I am judging how fast you reel in.
My gills hardly move.
One more twitch and I will bite.
I hide myself in the shadow of a stone.
I am waiting for your guard to drop.
I bite down on the hook's shank.
My tail slaps across the back of your hand.
I ram your shin, and it hurts.
My teeth rake your knuckles.
I thrash and splash water in your face.
That strike went wide, so here is another.
I shake my head and the line snaps taut.
Grab me and do not blame my fins.
My teeth are fine, and there are many.
Let go, and I leave.
I open my eyes in cold water.
The river sand holds me up.
Two schoolmates are already beside me.
Clear water lets me see the whole bend.
This is my first winter.
I flick my tail and try to move.
My shadow sits in the stone gap.
Snowmelt is coming down from upstream.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛一开始就很亮。
lines.en: My eyes are bright from the very start.
The river is long; I swim it slowly.

lines.zh: 火烤过我，鳞片反而熟了。
lines.en: Fire passes over me and cooks my scales.

lines.zh: 我从瀑布上摔下去，头晕。
lines.en: I fall down the waterfall with my head spinning.

lines.zh: 被提出水面，我喘不上气。
lines.en: Lifted out of the water, I cannot breathe.

lines.zh: 爆炸把河底的沙全掀起来。
lines.en: The blast lifts all the river sand.

lines.zh: 箭射穿水面，扎进我的背。
lines.en: An arrow pierces the surface and strikes my back.

lines.zh: 紫光一照，我的眼睛发花。
lines.en: Violet light hits and my eyes swim.
Winter runs long and hunger pins me to the bottom.

lines.zh: 雷打进河里，我浑身发麻。
lines.en: Lightning strikes the river and numbs me through.

lines.zh: 虚空没有水，我的鳃干得发疼。
lines.en: The void has no water; my gills ache dry.
